description: This file defines the ISystemAudioPlayer interface with its nested INotification interface, which provides virtual methods for controlling and monitoring system audio playback, such as play, pause, stop, set levels, and notifications.

classes.name: ISystemAudioPlayer
classes.description: Interface for controlling system audio playback and notifications.

classes.name: INotification
classes.description: Callback interface for system audio events notifications.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the audio player with the given service.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification sink for system audio events.

methods.name: IsPlaying
methods.description: Checks if audio is currently playing.

methods.name: Config
methods.description: Configures the player with specific parameters.

methods.name: GetPlayerSessionId
methods.description: Retrieves the current player session ID.
